participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Adventurous and optimistic, Emily is eager to embrace her newfound independence.
participant_1.background: I am 19 and I cannot wait to move out of my parents' home. I just want to have fun with my friends. I do not drink or do drugs or anything. I work part-time at Burger King.

participant_2.name: Mohamed
participant_2.personality: Resilient and thoughtful, Mohamed often reflects on his past experiences and values his freedom.
participant_2.background: I was born in Somalia. Now I live in the United States. My aunt helped me escape when I was young. I was forced to marry when I was a child.
